name: Happy Path — Employee Buys 350 CC from Company Store (All Valid Inputs)
goal: Verify a regular employee can successfully complete a new motorcycle purchase application for a 350 CC model via company store, providing all valid details.
constraints: All user inputs are valid and accepted on first attempt. Employee is eligible (first purchase). All workflows succeed.

phases.description: User selects 'Start New Application' from main menu.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot shows quick replies including 'Start New Application', user selects it, bot proceeds.
Bot says 'Seems like this is your first RE motorcycle purchase under the Employee discount Scheme'.

phases.description: User provides valid state and city.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot accepts state and city, both shown in Title Case.

phases.description: User selects 350 CC and a valid model.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot shows correct models for 350 CC, user selects one, bot proceeds.

phases.description: User selects Company Store and enters valid code.
User selects Cash, uploads undertaking letter.
User confirms application preview and submits.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot shows preview, user confirms, bot submits and displays UID.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
